subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this PR wait for retained after-fix Discord proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the current source-level tests plus unretained canary observation?
rationale: The code path looks focused and source-reproducible, but this is a user-visible Discord message-delivery change and the only after-fix live evidence is not inspectable.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs show failed draft progress suppressed and fallback warning delivery preserved.

options.title: Accept source-level evidence
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge based on the focused diff, tests, and operator canary note while owning the missing retained proof risk.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Leave the PR paused if neither the contributor nor a maintainer can capture the affected Discord path now.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs show failed draft progress suppressed and fallback warning delivery preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord progress-preview and shared progress work makes vincentkoc the strongest routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency call.
